proposal.name: clinical_model_operational_restriction_caveat
proposal.trigger: When a task involves reporting a predictive model for claims analysis that has not undergone external validation or clinical expert approval
proposal.objective: Ensure that predictive models intended for clinical or operational use in claims analysis explicitly declare their operational restrictions to prevent unauthorized deployment and protect clinical decision-making integrity
procedure: Identify whether the model workflow includes external validation (e.g., validation on held-out operational data, clinical expert review, or formal sign-off) or whether it is limited to development-data-only evaluation
If the model lacks external validation or clinical expert approval, add the 'no_operational_use' caveat to the write_report component's caveats parameter
Include explicit language in the report text stating that the model must not be deployed operationally without further validation and formal approval from domain experts or clinical leadership
Document in the report what additional steps (validation, approval, clinical review) would be required before operational use is considered
required_checks: 'no_operational_use' caveat is present in the report's caveats list
Report text contains explicit language stating the model is not approved for operational use
The caveat and restrictions are visible and unambiguous to intended stakeholders
expected_artifacts: report.md with no_operational_use caveat and clear operational restriction language
failure_modes: Model is deployed operationally before external validation is complete
Stakeholders misinterpret the model's approval status and use it in production inappropriately
Report lacks clear guidance on what validation steps are needed before operational use
